EnvironmentVariables.Comment: The following environment variables can be used for configuration:
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_BaseUrl: Base URL for the Terraform Registry
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_ModuleStoragePath: Local path to store modules (only required when StorageProvider is 'local')
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_ProviderStoragePath: Local path to store provider artifacts (only used when StorageProvider is 'local')
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_ProviderArtifactUrlExpiryMinutes: Expiry time in minutes for local provider artifact download tokens (default: 10 minutes)
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_Sqlite__ConnectionString: SQLite database connection string (e.g., Data Source=terraform.db)
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_AzureStorage__SasTokenExpiryMinut: Expiry time in minutes for SAS tokens (default: 5 minutes)
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_S3__AccessKeyId: S3 access key ID; omit to use AWS SDK default credentials
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_S3__SecretAccessKey: S3 secret access key; omit to use AWS SDK default credentials
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_S3__SessionToken: S3 session token; omit unless using temporary credentials
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_S3__PresignedUrlExpiryMinutes: Expiry time in minutes for S3 pre-signed download URLs (default: 5 minutes)
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_DatabaseRetry__MaxRetryAttempts: Maximum number of database connection retry attempts (default: 5)
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_DatabaseRetry__InitialDelaySecond: Initial delay in seconds before first retry (default: 2)
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_DatabaseRetry__MaxDelaySeconds: Maximum delay in seconds between retries (default: 30)
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_ModuleExtraction__Enabled: Enable async module documentation extraction (default: true)
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_ModuleExtraction__TempRoot: Temporary extraction root (default: OS temp directory)
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_ModuleExtraction__MaxArchiveBytes: Maximum accepted module archive size in bytes (default: 104857600)
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_ModuleExtraction__StartupBackfill: Number of existing modules to queue for extraction at startup (default: 25)
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_ApiKeySecurity__DigestKey: API-key HMAC digest key (minimum 32 characters; required outside Development)
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_ArtifactDownloadTokens__SigningKe: Artifact-download HMAC signing key (minimum 32 characters; required outside Development)
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_Oidc__JwtSecretKey: Secret key for signing JWT tokens (minimum 32 characters)
